articles.summary: Routes are URLs that a web client use to communicate with your application. In this article you will learn how Sails handles routes and how you can use them in your application.
articles.title: Understanding Sails routes

articles.summary: Your custom routes definitions can easily get out of hand in a large Sails application. In this article we are going to take a look at a pattern I use in large Sails applications for organizing custom routes definitions.
articles.title: One way to organize Sails routes
